frontmatter.condition: Opt-in — install is the boundary. Once composed, runs on an explicit `--stage formal-model-check` invocation (with or without `--single`); never auto-selected by a stock scope (scopes is empty).
frontmatter.inputs: the externalised TLA+ model + config under specs/tla/ (FormalElection.tla / FormalElection.cfg) and the run-model-check CLI (plugins/formal-model-check/tools/run-model-check.ts).
frontmatter.outputs: the TLC exhaustive-exploration verdict (exit 0 detected / 1 not-detected / 2 harness-error) plus the report/artifacts written under the chosen --out directory.
